2607.00989.title: SenseWalk: Agent-Based Semantic Trajectory Simulation Powered by Large Language Models in Zoned Environments
2607.00989.paper_summary: Semantic trajectory analysis has recently emerged as an approach for modeling human movement by capturing implicit patterns and behaviors through semantic information (e.g., visitors' profiles and goals) beyond raw spatial paths to better understand why people move in certain ways. However, analyzing semantic trajectories in real-world scenarios remains challenging, as collecting high-quality data is costly and often lacks rich semantic information. Meanwhile, existing simulation tools require substantial technical expertise, which makes them difficult for practitioners to adopt. To address these limitations, the paper proposes ${SenseWalk}$, an interactive system that supports simulating semantic trajectories by LLM-powered agents. We develop a simulation workflow that combines LLMs and the social force model to balance physical plausibility and semantic coherence. A user-friendly interface is designed to facilitate users in customizing the simulation configuration and analyzing simulation outputs. We also conduct a quantitative experiment to evaluate the effectiveness of our simulation workflow, and a user study (n=12) to assess the usefulness and efficiency of our system.
2607.00989.paper_summary_zh: 語義軌跡分析最近出現作為一種建模人類運動的方法，通過語義信息（例如，訪客的檔案和目標）捕捉隱含的模式和行為，超越原始的空間路徑，以更好地理解人們為何以特定方式移動。<lb/>然而，在現實世界場景中分析語義軌跡仍然具有挑戰性，因為收集高質量數據的成本高昂，且通常缺乏豐富的語義信息。<lb/>同時，現有的模擬工具需要相當的技術專業知識，這使得從業者難以採用。<lb/>為了解決這些限制，本文提出了${SenseWalk}$，一個支持通過LLM驅動的代理模擬語義軌跡的互動系統。<lb/>我們開發了一個模擬工作流程，結合LLM和社會力模型，以平衡物理合理性和語義一致性。<lb/>設計了一個用戶友好的界面，以便用戶自定義模擬配置並分析模擬輸出。<lb/>我們還進行了一個定量實驗，以評估我們的模擬工作流程的有效性，以及一項用戶研究（n=12）來評估我們系統的實用性和效率。
